summary: Payment batch skipped: non-numeric early-payment discount ('5%') in vendor invoice metadata caused parser error
description:
Issue summary:
The AP payment engine skipped batch PAY-2026-03-10-742 after the AP parser raised a validation error when reading the 'early payment discount' field from vendor invoice INV-988172 (Novus Logistics). The discount field contains the literal '5%' (trailing percent sign). The parser expects a decimal numeric (e.g., 0.05) and throws a validation exception that causes the batch to be marked as failed and placed on manual hold.

Impact:
- One scheduled payout (batch PAY-2026-03-10-742) was placed on manual hold, affecting 12 invoices across 7 vendors (immediate impact: Novus Logistics payment delayed ~3 days).
- Risk of supplier dissatisfaction and potential late-fee accrual if not cleared before next run.

Environment:
- Production AP pipeline (AP-processor v2.7.1), eu-west region, payment rails: SEPA (primary), fallback: SWIFT.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Upload invoice with metadata field "early_payment_discount" set to "5%" (example INV-988172 attached).
2) Trigger AP batch creation using nightly job (PAY-2026-03-10-742).
3) Parser validation layer (ap-parser) attempts to coerce field to float; validation fails with ValueError due to non-numeric char (%).
4) Batch flagged as ERROR and moved to manual_hold queue.

Attachments / evidence:
- Invoice: INV-988172_novus_invoice.pdf (uploaded to ticket).
- Batch: PAY-2026-03-10-742 (job logs).
- AP-processor logs excerpt: "ap_parser.ValidationError: invalid literal for float(): '5%' at ap_parser/fields.py:128"
- Slack thread: #finance-helpdesk thread t12345 (link included below).
steps_to_reproduce: Upload invoice with early_payment_discount value containing a '%' character
Run nightly AP batch job PAY-2026-03-10-742
Observe parser exception and batch moved to manual_hold
logs: ap_parser.ValidationError: invalid literal for float(): '5%' at ap_parser/fields.py:128
PaymentScheduler: skipped 12 invoices in batch PAY-2026-03-10-742
comments: Aisha Patel (Finance): Raised when Novus reported delayed payment; batch shows validation exception in AP logs.
Marcus Chen (Finance Ops): Investigating parser behavior; current workaround is manual override per-invoice in AP console to set numeric discount (0.05).
SRE (Elena Novak): Confirmed parser throws on any non-digit character; sending brief patch to tolerant parsing and logging before deploy.
Marcus Chen: Initiated manual payment for Novus Logistics via ad-hoc wire to clear immediate supplier impact; recorded in PAY-ADHOC-20260311.
Engineering (PR team): Drafted PR to sanitize discount input by stripping percent signs and converting '5%' -> 0.05; running unit tests.
Finance (Aisha): Please include acceptance criteria to ensure no change to discount semantics (percentage vs absolute).
investigation_notes: 03-10: Reproduced locally by uploading sample payload with '5%'; ap-parser uses float() coercion without pre-cleaning.

03-11 09:12 UTC: Confirmed 12 invoices across 7 vendors used nonstandard discount formatting; source of metadata varies: some from vendor portal CSV exports, some from third-party invoice ingestion (OCR).

03-11 11:45 UTC: Temporary mitigation - finance ops applied manual numeric overrides for all affected invoices and retried the batch; 9 invoices paid successfully in re-run, 3 required bank manual payments.
03-11 16:00 UTC: Root cause: input normalization absent for percentage strings. Expected input model allows either decimal (0.05) or percentage string ('5%') but parser only accepts decimal.
03-12 08:22 UTC: Safety patch created to tolerant-parse percentage strings and reject malformed inputs with clear error codes. PR: github.com/redwood-finance/ap/compare/fix/percent-parse (PR #4127)
resolution: Workaround applied: Finance Ops performed manual numeric overrides (0.05) for affected invoices and retried the batch; Novus Logistics paid via ad-hoc wire PAY-ADHOC-20260311. Permanent fix: merged PR #4127 to sanitize percentage strings in ap-parser and added unit tests and integration test in staging. Patch scheduled for deploy to prod 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC with rollback runbook.
resolution_notes: Temporary: manual override and ad-hoc wire cleared urgent supplier payments.
Permanent: parser patch to strip '%' and convert percentage string to decimal; also added validation error code AP-VAL-004 for malformed discount values.
Follow-up: product to update vendor CSV ingestion docs to declare allowed formats; vendor outreach to Novus for future exports.
Post-deploy monitoring: AP batch success rates and parser validation errors monitored for 72h after deploy; dashboard: finance.ap/monitoring#parser-errors
